risks.title: Sensitivity to economic cycles
risks.score_rationale: Automotive production is cyclical and sensitive to general economic conditions, interest rates, and consumer spending. A decline in production would have a material negative impact on the company's sales.

risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Prices of raw materials and commodities can fluctuate and impact the company's costs, although volatility has decreased in 2025.

risks.title: Intensified competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive automotive supply market and faces competition from other global suppliers.

risks.title: Regulatory and tariff risks
risks.score_rationale: Government regulatory changes, tariffs, and tax incentives for electric vehicles can have a material impact on the company's sales and costs.

risks.title: Litigation and claims
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in claims and legal proceedings, including product liability and contractual indemnification matters.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and operational disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks and must protect its systems and data, as demonstrated by a cybersecurity-related disruption at a European customer in 2025.

risks.title: Climate and natural risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to natural disaster risks, as demonstrated by the impact of the hurricane in North Carolina in 2024, which could disrupt operations.
